Right before the Hanshin JF.
My tension begins to mount, but—
Air Groove was more focused than usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. It is too early.
Such words belong after proper results have been achieved.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Behold as I—deliver a performance truly worthy of the "Empress."
